test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: M, N, O, X, Y and Z are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). O is an immediate neighbour of Y. Z sits second to the right of O. X is the immediate neighbour of both M and N. Mis not an immediate neighbour of O. Who sits to the immediate left of Y?
solution:
Given: M, N, O, X, Y and Z are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) O is an immediate neighbour of Y.

2) Z sits second to the right of O.

3) X is the immediate neighbour of both M and N.

4) M is not an immediate neighbour of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71c06068a090d1407cc9fabd0dee63c4fdfd4823cfa8cc790e7fd8ff94c8da09.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9639bcf1740bce028751f2905d61a8c0d3c0a75b1098866bbce36b8d21c48e92.png] 

Thus, 'O' is sitting to the immediate left of Y.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
